identity.title: Export Completeness per-cell Run Record results

origin.summary: The owner approved continuing after PL-0021; the master backlog selects L-12 Completeness per-cell result export.

state.current_summary: PL-0022 is complete: schema 1.9 preserves exact typed Completeness cell evidence and matching JSON, readable HTML, and structured CSV child rows without rerunning inspection; compatibility, Release, structure, and refreshed R0 prerequisite checks pass.

objective.summary: Preserve exact Completeness per-cell evidence in current Run Records and export it as readable HTML and structured CSV child rows.
constraints: Reuse the existing C3DCompletenessGridMetricOutput produced by ordered execution; do not rerun or reconstruct the inspection from flattened metrics.
Preserve cell identity, zero-based grid and source region coordinates, counts, finite coverage, nullable raw heights, unit, frame, decision, reason, and content identity.
Keep non-Completeness and legacy Run Records readable and do not change recipe, source, acceptance, Preview, Publish, Run, or Validation behavior.
Retain JSON, HTML, and CSV agreement and refresh fixed R0 inputs after binary changes.

criteria.text: Ordered Run Record schema preserves the exact typed Completeness output and all deterministic per-cell evidence without another inspection execution.
JSON, HTML, and CSV expose matching cell identity, coordinates, region, counts, coverage, nullable heights, unit/frame, decision, reason, and content identity.
Non-Completeness and legacy records remain readable, while missing or malformed current cell evidence fails safely rather than fabricating rows.
Focused Completeness, ordered Runner/Shell, reporting, Release, structure, and refreshed R0 input validation pass with durable D-backed evidence.

context.summary: C3DCompletenessGridMetricOutput already owns exact deterministic cell evidence and content identity.
The current projection retains metrics and overlays but drops the typed Completeness output.
Current HTML and CSV emit step metric rows and need exact Completeness child rows.

evidence.observation: Completeness verification passed 30/30, including ReferenceEquals proof that ordered projection reuses the exact typed C3DCompletenessGridMetricOutput instance and schema 1.9 retains its four cells and content SHA-256 without reconstruction or re-execution.

Field-by-field JSON/CSV comparison and HTML identity inspection passed for all 4/4 known cells under schema 1.9, including coordinates, regions, sample counts, coverage, nullable values, unit, frame, decision, reason, and content hash.

The focused suite proves schema 1.8 records without cell evidence remain readable, unrelated records retain null Completeness evidence, and missing or malformed current Completeness evidence is rejected rather than fabricated.

Final Release built with 0 warnings and 0 errors; affected Runner checks passed 22/22, 21/21, and 23/23; Shell checks passed 15/15, 12/12, 87/87, and 40/40; structure passed 29/29; refreshed Wide and Compact fixed-input R0 ValidateOnly passed without launching the application.
